artifacts.sourceArchiveVerification: Re-downloaded from the official SourceForge project on 2026-07-26. The 2009 import contains all 20 library and build files from the 21-file archive and omits only samples/example.cpp. After normalizing line endings, 16 files are exact. The four import-time differences are reviewable local changes: a null-safe TTATester cleanup, an upgraded x86/x64 Visual C++ project, and an include/forward-declaration cleanup in TTAReader.cpp and TTAReader.h. Later changes remain attributable in Git history.
artifacts.historicalChecksumStatus: No checksum captured in 2009 can be created retroactively. The surviving official archive is pinned by current SHA-256 and byte-compared with the import, so present source identity and every local delta are reviewable; only the unprovable claim that SourceForge never republished those same versioned bytes is excluded.

artifacts.limitations: SourceForge does not expose a checksum captured contemporaneously with the 2009 import. The current versioned archive hash plus file-level comparison establishes the source family and exact local delta, but does not cryptographically prove that SourceForge never republished the archive. Current source also contains later CUETools build, include-case, and warning cleanup recorded in Git.
artifacts.retentionDecision: Retain the source-built mixed-mode codec. Its complete current source, official versioned archive, import delta, later Git history, build recipe, and output hashes are available; the irrecoverable absence of a 2009 checksum is disclosed rather than treated as unfinished local work.

artifacts.upstream: Christopher Key's HDCD decoder; original download URL unknown
attributionEvidence: Commit bbb87a2d490d9699bbeb5bed2c0eb14cbfe348de: wrapper for Christopher Key's HDCD decoder
Commit 4bd778c59484c4b3849834c5ed7534b2271934e3: HDCD detection and decoding with library by Christopher Key
License.txt: redistribution license and copyright notice for hdcd.dll
artifacts.buildEvidence: Both binaries have 2008-11-13 PE timestamps and linker version 8.00 (Visual Studio 2005 toolchain family), no version resource, no Authenticode signature, no PDB path, and the same 19-function hdcd_decoder_* ABI.
historicalUpstreamEvidence: The Internet Archive capture of http://www.srcf.ucam.org/~cjk32/hdcd/ from 2008-09-18 lists Christopher Key's public hdcd-r71, r91, r166, r172, and r185 reference-decoder archives.
Import-era discussion links CUETools/eac3to HDCD decoding to Christopher Key, while the public archives expose the command-line reference decoder rather than this DLL ABI.
FFmpeg's maintained HDCD filter independently records that its original algorithm was reverse engineered from Christopher Key's decoder library.

sourceBuiltReplacementProbe.localInputVerification: The owner-provided C:\_Audio Codecs_\HDCD\libhdcd-master tree contains the same 42 files as the official v1.4 commit. After CRLF/LF normalization, every source, header, build, and test-vector file is byte-identical; only .gitignore differs.
sourceBuiltReplacementProbe.buildEvidence: The official source built successfully for x64 and x86 with current MSVC through a minimal CMake harness. Its public API is a stereo in-place processor and is not the retained DLL's 19-function hdcd_decoder_* ABI.
compatibilityCorpus: hdcd-pfa.wav: 438273/441000 scaled PCM samples equal; packet count 45 vs 98 and decoded samples differ.
hdcd-tgm.wav: 412586/441000 scaled PCM samples equal; packet count 53 vs 107 and target-gain behavior differs.

hdcd-ftm.wav: the legacy decoder reports no detection/statistics while libhdcd reports effectual HDCD with 200 packets; 881819/882000 scaled PCM samples equal but the differing samples include large deltas.
hdcd-all.wav: 2604083/2646016 scaled PCM samples equal; packet count 422 vs 869 and decoded samples differ.
ava16.wav: all 882000 scaled PCM samples equal for the non-HDCD control.
hdcd.wav: 805039/811008 scaled PCM samples equal; packet count 92 vs 184 and decoded samples differ.
sourceBuiltReplacementProbe.verdict: Not a behavior-compatible replacement. Keep the source-built candidate behind a new-engine/compatibility gate unless a future adapter reproduces legacy detection, statistics, packet accounting, gain, decoded PCM, and reset/flush semantics on the corpus.

artifacts.verification: Packaged bytes are hash-bound; the WPF release probe initializes and closes the x64 decoder. A six-vector old-vs-new compatibility probe independently proved that the current open-source libhdcd cannot silently replace these bytes.
artifacts.limitations: The author/library family, redistribution license, import-era evidence, ABI, and compiler family are recorded. Exact source revision, original DLL download URL, compiler build, flags, and build recipe remain unknown.
artifacts.retentionDecision: Retain the two hash-bound legacy binaries until a source-built replacement passes old-vs-new HDCD detection, decoded-PCM, statistics, and flush/reset compatibility tests. Do not describe these bytes as reproducibly built or silently substitute a related open decoder without that behavioral proof.

artifacts.licenseSource: eng/release/licenses/LAME-3.100-LICENSE.txt and eng/release/licenses/GNU-LGPL-2.0.txt, copied from the official LAME 3.100 source archive with line endings, page-break controls, and insignificant horizontal whitespace normalized
artifacts.buildEvidence: File version 3.100; PE timestamps are 2017-10-22 07:46:33 UTC (x86) and 08:00:39 UTC (x64), linker version 14.00. Embedded PDB paths identify RareWares build trees: E:\lame-3.100-CVS\output\ReleaseNASM\libmp3lame.pdb (x86) and E:\lame-3.100-CVS\output\Release\libmp3lame.pdb (x64).

artifacts.retentionDecision: Retain the hash-bound RareWares 3.100 binaries for the current release. Replace them only through the separately gated LAME 4 source-build project, with MP3 ABI, decode, corpus, and quality evidence; do not invent an unrecoverable third-party build recipe.

artifacts.verification: The workflow pins checkout, run-vcpkg, and upload actions to immutable commits; uses FFmpeg.AutoGen 8.1.0; runs deterministic AIFF path and stream decodes, exact PCM checks, seek replay, disposal, and managed-callback exception containment under x64 and x86; and emits the FFmpeg license, exact vcpkg port manifest, DLL hashes, file versions, and build inputs.
artifacts.limitations: These DLLs are emitted by a separate manual workflow and are not included by the current classic or WPF release collection. The probe covers the reachable AIFF decoder contract rather than every format supported by FFmpeg.
